Diagnosis: `uniqueId()` used only the report name, creating one global `sales` lock across all tenants. Tenant 42’s job was therefore discarded when another tenant’s sales job already held the lock.
Fix:
- Uniqueness is now scoped to `report + tenant ID`.
- Removed the one-hour expiry so delayed jobs cannot lose their lock and overlap.
